name: prompt_flash
description: Stage 9 (PDF 2.3 prompt engineering): one factor at a time from the shipped default (Milo, the best persona on Flash-Lite in Stage 8; visible Thought lines; one worked example; instructions in the system prompt) on the core set. no-cot: no Thought lines (hidden reasoning stays at Milo's 'low'). zero-shot: no worked example (an ablation: the shipped block always keeps it). few-shot: two more examples (a lead, a NO_MATCH). in-message: the system prompt holds only the persona; the tools and instructions go in front of the customer's message.
